en: Vintage illustrated postcard showing a riverside view of Graz, with a bridge in the foreground, horse‑drawn carts and pedestrians, a row of multi‑storey buildings along the river, a church tower, and a hill with a fortification and clock tower in the background. The left side is decorated with oak leaves and a heraldic shield featuring a silver lion on a green field. The top has ornamental elements with birds and the city name. A round emblem with floral motifs and text is printed on the upper right.
